title: Luxe Estate
summary: Property search with filters synced to the map, multilingual content and server-first rendering.
description: A full-stack real estate platform built on Next.js Server Components and Server Actions, with Supabase for data and auth, Leaflet for map search and multilingual content.
challenges: The Leaflet map and the server-side filters had to stay in sync.
Favorites and sign-in felt slow when every action waited for a round trip to the server.
Property pages had to load fast and be indexable by search engines.
solutions: Filters run as server-side queries through Supabase PostgREST, which keeps the map and the result list consistent.
Server Actions validate their input strictly and pair with optimistic UI, so favorites and sign-in respond without waiting.
Pages render with Server Components first, which sends less JavaScript to the browser and keeps content crawlable.
